content.text: tx = corticosteroids alone or w cyclophosphamide, MTX or azathioprine, by severity; mild to moderate (no serious neuro, renal, GI or cardiac dz): corticosteroids + MTX or azathioprine; severe (neuro, renal, GI or cardiac involvement): cyclophosphamide + corticosteroids may improve outcome.
Contraindicated in systemic fungal infect. ⍉live vaccines @ immunosuppressive doses. Caution: HF, HTN, renal insuff; peptic ulcer, diverticulitis (perf risk).

CYP3A4 inducers (phenytoin, carbamazepine, RIF, barbiturates) may require a higher steroid dose; inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, erythromycin) raise levels. NSAIDs/ASA: ↑ GI SE. Warfarin: response USU inhibited; monitor INR often. K-depleting diuretics: watch for hypokalemia.
consider osteoporosis prev (calcium, vitD, bisphos, weight-bearing exercise); use the lowest effective dose and duration.
Don't stop abruptly; taper after prolonged use (AI risk for up to 12 months). Tell other clinicians you take steroids; seek care promptly for fever or infect.
